items.text: Rubio, a day after Machado returned to Venezuela, says "you can't protest your way to democracy" and ties elections to reforms: Supreme Court overhaul by end-2026, new electoral council in early 2027, and about $300B of debt. Rodríguez would first declare the presidency vacant, starting a six-month period; best case is elections by June 2027, with 2028 not ruled out.

items.context: Net effect (my reading): Machado is back inside the country, which raises street pressure on the US-Rodríguez arrangement; Rubio's Oct 26-27 remarks show how Washington answered. The conflicting accounts of US involvement are unresolved. No fx.

Evidence: US official quoted via several outlets; Rodriguez roadmap per one digest. Not established: a formal date or the official's identity. Counter-reading: a 2027 date lets oil dealmakers keep Rodriguez until then. Falsifier: US shifts to earlier elections or drops the vacancy demand. Provisional.
